cards.heading: Order in Heaven, order on earth

blocks.text: There is order in Heaven. We have God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit, followed by the Four Living Beings, the Twenty-Four Elders, the Archangels, the Cherubim and Seraphim, and then the ordinary angels - {{1co 15:41|1 Corinthians 15:41}}. As it is in Heaven, so it is here on earth: the Redeemed Christian Church of God maintains a hierarchy for the sake of orderliness.

That hierarchy runs from the General Overseer, who is the spiritual head, through the Deputy General Overseer, the Mother-in-Israel, the Assistant General Overseers, the National Elders, National Secretaries, Special Assistants to the General Overseer, the Directors, Pastors in Charge of Regions and Provinces (with their Assistant Pastors), Church Growth Officers, Pastors in Charge of Zones, Areas and Parishes, Assistant Pastors, Deacons and Deaconesses, non-ordained Ministers, Workers, Workers-in-Training, baptised members, saved non-baptised members, newcomers, and those yet to be saved.
